name: Masked Line Reveal
description: A GSAP SplitText line reveal: each line of a heading or paragraph rises out of its own mask, one after another, when it scrolls into view. Lines follow the real line breaks and re-split on resize.

props.name: children
props.description: The text. Inline markup (em, strong, links) is kept.

props.name: trigger
props.description: 'view' plays once when the text scrolls into view; 'mount' plays right away.

props.name: start
props.description: When 'view' starts, as a ScrollTrigger start.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element, if the text sits inside its own scroll container.
